summary: Retested the Newsletter tab update in Preview (DRY_RUN). The 'Adresse de test' checkbox, the 'Test' badge, PATCH /admin/newsletter/{id} and the is_test exclusion are all gone. Selection is now explicit: a 'Destinataire' checkbox on eligible rows only, plus a 'Tout sélectionner/Tout désélectionner' button and an 'N sélectionné(s)' counter. Nothing is pre-selected, all_eligible is no longer honoured, and an empty selection returns 400. Backend: test_newsletter_admin.py 22/22 passed and test_compliance_rgpd.py 15/15 passed. Extra checks: recipient_ids over 5000 -> 422, unknown id -> 400. cleanup_test_data.py was run in simulation mode only (0 rows matched, nothing deleted). Frontend (Playwright, fictif-qa-ui- seeded rows) passed every step: rows with an old is_test flag are now eligible and selectable; unsubscribed and unproven-consent rows have no checkbox; select-all selects 3 and deselect-all returns to 0; the send button is disabled at 0 and the count stays in sync; a test send keeps the selection (the iteration_10 bug is fixed); the confirm dialog shows '2 abonnés sélectionnés'; the dry-run campaign went to exactly the 2 selected addresses; afterwards the form and selection reset. Removing a selected subscriber also removes it from the selection.

minor.issue: Still open from iteration_10: the 'sending' guard is not atomic (find_one, then insert).

issues: Email addresses wrap every few characters because the status and consent pills share the same row (break-all with flex-1). Put the pills on their own line below the email on small screens.

action_items: Optional: fix the email wrapping on mobile in SubscriberList rows.
critical_code_review_comments: cleanup_test_data.py: the case-insensitive regex 'test' matches any substring, so real addresses or names such as 'contest@', 'attestation', 'Testard' or 'celestest' would be hard-deleted with --apply. Review the dry-run list before applying, or use a stricter pattern (e.g. a word boundary or a known prefix).
cleanup_test_data.py uses delete_many on newsletter, which removes consent proof. That is intended for test data, but be careful in production.

newsletter-selected-count shows selected.size while the send button uses the filtered eligible count. These currently match because removal deletes the id from the selection, but they could drift if a selected subscriber becomes ineligible on refetch (e.g. unsubscribes in the meantime). Consider deriving both from the same filtered list.
The is_test field stays in the DB documents but is ignored, which is fine. It is still returned in the list payload.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 5 fictif-qa-ui-* newsletter rows and QA-UI campaigns for the UI test, then cleaned them up (python tests/seed_newsletter_ui.py --clean). The pytest fixture cleans fictif-qa-* rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the newsletter tests with -n 0. Seed UI rows with backend/tests/seed_newsletter_ui.py and remove them with --clean. NEWSLETTER_DRY_RUN=true in Preview. Admin credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Never run cleanup_test_data.py with --apply.
